summary: Pyxis Oncology filed a Form 8-K regarding a securities purchase agreement for a private placement on June 30, 2026. The company agreed to issue 19,600,153 common shares at $2.551 per share and common warrants to purchase an equal number of shares at $3.289 per warrant, exercisable after clinical data disclosure or October 1, 2026, expiring July 2, 2029. Gross proceeds are ~$50M upfront, with up to ~$64M if warrants are exercised. This is a capital-raising transaction, not a special situation like an acquisition or restructuring.
